summary: The patch addresses the issue of adding a nullable OneToOneField on SQLite by modifying the schema editor to handle such fields differently. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The patch introduces new test files (`reproduce.py`, `reproduce2.py`, `reproduce3.py`, `reproduce4.py`) which are not part of the diff but are expected. Ensure these tests are integrated into the project's test suite.
